http_429_policy: Stop the active batch; no retry loop
scope_contract: Broad discovery metadata is kept separate from substantive Case 03–Casanare inclusion decisions. This crawler fetches no transcripts or media.
snapshot_selection_rule: Prefer an exhausted, count-reconciled include-unavailable view. Preserve the default-visible snapshot under alternate_snapshot_views; its earlier discrepancy remains historical evidence, not an unresolved selected-view gap.

count_definitions.returned_memberships: Returned list positions, including unavailable placeholders and repeated appearances
count_definitions.visible_memberships: Legacy alias of returned_memberships; NOT playable video count
count_definitions.normal_title_memberships: Returned positions with a nonempty public title, excluding known unavailable placeholders; playability not implied
count_definitions.unique_video_ids: Distinct public video IDs within the collection; includes placeholder IDs
count_definitions.hidden_unavailable_count: Numeric hidden count explicitly stated by the selected view; placeholders returned by Show unavailable are counted separately
count_definitions.unavailable_placeholder_memberships: Returned blank-title placeholder positions revealed by the normal unavailable-item action
count_definitions.count_reconciled: Declared count equals returned positions plus any explicitly numbered entries still hidden
count_definitions.pagination_exhausted: No actual primary-list continuation remains, with no crawl error or cycle; does not establish complete historical availability
